title: The Grindhouse
description:
S01 E05 — Lady frankenstein
Lady Frankenstein is a typical exploitation sex & horror flick from the early 1970s; for the most part, it has one distinguishing quality that elevates it from the usual dross: its leading lady, Rosalba Neri.
